english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when you mean alcoholic drinks generally.
Use this for an alcoholic drink being served or for alcoholic beverages in general.
Use this for intoxicating liquor or alcohol in general, especially when the container is not important.
Use this when “sauce” is slang for alcohol or booze.
Use this broader noun for an alcoholic drink such as rice wine, fruit wine, or plum wine when the exact type is clear from context.
